text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0565, Agreement]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to execute a four and one-half year funding agreement with the California Highway Patrol (CHP) to provide enforcement services on the Metro ExpressLanes from January 1, 2027 to June 30, 2031, in the Not-To-Exceed amount of $26,092,181.
summary: Metro would authorize a funding agreement of up to $26,092,181 for the California Highway Patrol to enforce traffic rules on the Metro ExpressLanes from January 2027 through June 2031.

details.action: funding agreement for CHP enforcement services
